node.statement: Proposition 2.3 (Symmetric subspace projector recurrence): For n >= 2 and 1 <= m <= n, Pi_sym^{n,d} = ((e+X_n)/n) * ((e+X_{n-1})/(n-1)) * ... * ((e+X_{m+1})/(m+1)) * (Pi_sym^{m,d} tensor I^{tensor(n-m)}). This follows from Proposition 2.2 and the formula Pi_sym^{n,d} = (1/n!)(e+X_n)...(e+X_1), by factoring out the terms for indices > m and recognizing the remaining product as (m!) * Pi_sym^{m,d}.
